post.summary: Answer a game
post.description: Anyone but the sender can answer: a `hand` for rock paper scissors, a `pick` and `seed` for dice, `n` to try a number, `shots` and `dives` for the penalty shootout, a `letter` for hangman, a `choice` for two truths and a lie or would you rather, a `sealed` typed guess for the emoji riddle or draw and guess, or a `shot` at the boats. On tic-tac-toe (`cell`) and connect four (`col`) the sender takes turns too. The first answer that fits settles the one-go games; the others go on until they end. Everyone gets message.edited with the new `moves`.

action.description: What a `service` message announces: `auto_delete` means the sender set the timer to `secs` (null: off); `theme` means they set the chat background (null: back to each person's default); `e2ee` marks where end-to-end encryption starts; `vanish` means the sender turned vanish mode on or off; `pin` means they pinned a message; `screenshot` means they took a screenshot of the chat (only detected on the web, and not everywhere); `call` logs a call the sender made; `live_invite` is posted in your chat when `from` asks you to a live game; `live_result` is how a live game you played alone against Six Frites Game ended, for you; in a group, `group_created`, `joined`, `left`, `removed`, `renamed` and `group_photo` tell what happened to the group and to whom (`name` is how they showed there)

post.summary: Ask the sender to encrypt a message again
post.description: For an encrypted message your device can't open, as when it signed in after the message was sent. Sets `encryption.reseal` to requested, everyone gets message.edited so the sender's devices can offer to seal it again, and the sender gets a push. Asking again after it failed starts over. MESSAGE_NOT_EDITABLE if it isn't encrypted or was destroyed.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated message ids, at most 100

get.summary: Messages in a chat, newest first

parameters.name: only
parameters.description: media: photos and videos; files; links: text messages that may hold a link (every encrypted one, since only your device can read it); text: messages that can hold text, captions included, for searching on your device. Leaves out deleted and self-destructing messages.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only messages sent at or after this time

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Only messages sent before this time

parameters.name: until

post.summary: Send a message
post.description: Idempotent per `clientId`: retrying with the same clientId returns the original message. Send `encrypted` with one envelope per device of every member (your other devices included, not this one); DEVICES_CHANGED lists what to fix. The first encrypted message turns encryption on for the chat, after which plain text is refused with ENCRYPTION_REQUIRED.

delete.description: Deletes your direct chat with its messages and files, and the names and photos you gave each other. You disappear from each other's contacts; both get chat.deleted with scope `me`. Either of you can add the other again.

value.description: For color, highlight (a background behind the text) and outline (a line around its letters): a TEXT_COLORS or TEXT_GRADIENTS name, #rrggbb, or #rrggbb-#rrggbb; for font: a TEXT_FONTS name; for size: a whole size in points, 8 to 48

effect.description: How a text message shows: in flames, gift-wrapped until opened, or with hearts or confetti when it arrives

silent.description: Sent with `/silent`: it arrives without a notification or sound

bump.description: A bump: it brings the message in `replyTo` back to the bottom of the chat, as Messenger does

vanish.description: Sent in vanish mode: it disappears once the other person has read it and left the chat

kind.description: `gif` uploads are only created by sending a `gifId`; `sticker` files go into sticker packs; a `sticker_zip` (admins only) is imported into official packs

status.description: `removed`: a large file a moderator deleted to free space

url.description: Signed link to the playable or viewable file, once ready

encrypted.description: The file is encrypted; its key, name, type and preview are in the message content

format.description: `lottie`: a Lottie JSON animation. `image`: a static WebP or PNG.

url.description: Null while an uploaded sticker is still being processed

views.description: How many times the recipient opened it

locked.description: Content is withheld for you; open it with POST /v1/messages/{id}/view

expired.description: Its views or timer ran out; the recipient can no longer open it

purged.description: Content permanently deleted; it can no longer be resent

resent.description: The sender re-armed it after it was opened

resendsLeft.description: How many more times the sender can re-arm it

resendUntil.description: Until when the sender can resend it, once it has been opened

groupId.description: Photos and videos sent together share it and show as one album

threadId.description: In a group, the message this one comments on; it then shows only in that message's comments

thread.description: A group message's comments; null on comments themselves and on service messages

closed.description: Its comments are closed, by an admin or by `limit` or `closesAt`: nobody can add one until an admin reopens them

limit.description: Comments close once this many come from people other than its author

encrypted.description: The quoted text is encrypted; show it from your own copy of that message

sentAt.description: When the quoted message was sent

ownerId.description: Whose story or note it is

kind.description: note: a note they answered, its text in `text`

text.description: The start of the story's text or caption

background.description: A text story's colour, or two for a gradient

imageUrl.description: A photo story's picture, or a video's first frame; it stops working once the story is gone

story.description: The story or note a message answers, as it was when they answered: it may be gone since

secs.description: How long it lasted; null if it was missed or declined

ended.description: The game is over and its room closed, so there is nothing to join

score.description: Your score, then the bot's best, in the games that keep one: boxes, pairs or word points

action.description: What a `service` message announces: `auto_delete` means the sender set the timer to `secs` (null: off); `theme` means they set the chat background (null: back to each person's default); `e2ee` marks where end-to-end encryption starts; `vanish` means the sender turned vanish mode on or off; `pin` means they pinned a message; `screenshot` means they took a screenshot of the chat (only detected on the web, and not everywhere); `call` logs a call the sender made; `live_invite` is posted in your chat when `from` asks you to a live game; `live_result` is how a live game you played alone against Six Frites Game ended, for you; in a group, `group_created`, `joined`, `left`, `removed`, `renamed` and `group_photo` tell what happened to the group and to whom (`name` is how they showed there)

accuracy.description: How far off it may be, in meters

name.description: What the place is called, for a place picked on the map

checks.description: The checklist items marked done; either person can tick them

key.description: A key the typed answers are sealed with, so only people who can read the game can read them
A key the typed answers are sealed with, so only people who can read the game can read them

moves.description: Answers to the game, oldest first; anyone but the sender can play

deletedBy.description: Who deleted it for everyone: the sender, or the other person in a direct chat

expiresAt.description: When the chat's auto-delete timer removes it for everyone

emoji.description: The emoji, or `sticker:<id>` / `gif:<id>` for a sticker or GIF; also what removes it

reactedAt.description: When each of them reacted, by user id

sticker.description: For a sticker reaction; null once the sticker is gone

format.description: `lottie`: a Lottie JSON animation. `image`: a static WebP or PNG.

url.description: Null while an uploaded sticker is still being processed

gif.description: For a GIF reaction, as an MP4 to play muted on a loop

reactions.description: One entry per emoji, sticker or GIF, oldest first; a person can add several different ones

encryption.description: Set for end-to-end encrypted messages: `text`, `entities`, `spoiler` and `effect` are then empty and the content is in your device's envelope

senderDeviceId.description: The device that encrypted it; open the envelope with your session with it

dhPub.description: X25519 identity key, signed by signPub

dhSig.description: A 64-byte Ed25519 signature, base64url without padding

ephemeral.description: A 32-byte public key, base64url without padding

envelopes.description: Only the envelopes for your own devices

backup.description: Your backup copy, if you stored one

reseal.description: `requested`: `by` couldn't decrypt it and asked the sender to encrypt it again (PUT /v1/messages/{id}/envelopes). `failed`: the sender's device couldn't read it either

pinnedMessages.description: Shared by both people: the messages pinned at the top of the chat, newest pin first, at most 20

scheduledCount.description: Your scheduled messages waiting to be sent in this chat

draft.description: Just yours: what you were typing here, saved by one of your devices for the others; null until one does

text.description: Plain text; null when cleared, or when it is sealed

sealed.description: Sealed with your backup key, so only your devices can read it

blockedByMe.description: You blocked the other person: nobody can send, react or edit until you unblock

peerDeleted.description: The other person deleted their account

encrypted.description: Messages here are end-to-end encrypted from now on; sending plain text is refused (ENCRYPTION_REQUIRED)

support.description: A support chat with a guest from the support page: only text, photos and replies can be sent, and nobody can call

supportDesk.description: You answer this chat for support; the person you're helping sees you as Six Frites

withSupport.description: Your chat with Six Frites support: no calls, no presence, and text and photos only

supportClosedAt.description: When support closed this conversation; the next message opens it again

delete.description: Admins remove members; only the owner removes admins. They can't come back through the link.

post.summary: Leave a group
post.description: An owner who leaves hands the group to the longest-serving admin, or else the longest-serving member. The last one out deletes it.

get.summary: An animated emoji as Lottie JSON, by its code points (like 1f600 or 2764_fe0f)
